formats.name: Headline joke
formats.instruction: Classic topical joke: the setup takes the headline somewhere expected, the punchline twists it.

formats.name: Honest headline
formats.instruction: Setup: the official version of the story, sharpened to 12 words max, starting with 'Officially:'. Punchline: the honest version, what it actually means for normal people, starting with 'Honestly:'.

formats.name: Relatable
formats.instruction: Setup connects the headline to an everyday situation almost everyone knows (office, family, roommates, relationships). Punchline is the exaggerated, recognisable reaction.
